content: <1>{{name}}</1> will be moved to Trash, where you can restore it for 30 days. After that, it's permanently deleted.

comment.text: Body text of the Move to Trash? confirmation dialog shown when a user deletes one file or folder. {{name}} is the item's name and <1></1> makes it bold; Trash is the name of the Trash section; it stays restorable for 30 days, after which it is deleted automatically.
